signal: Sensi AI launched a Unified Agentic Operating System for home care and raised a $45M Series C with 400% revenue growth

email.subject1: a signal play for Sensi AI
email.body1:
Alon, saw Sensi AI launched its Unified Agentic Operating System for home care off the $45M Series C and 400 percent growth.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sensi AI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alon, quick follow-up for Sensi AI.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. As CRO you feel that first, and most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sensi AI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alon, last bit of proof for Sensi AI.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sensi AI's reply rate likely compares to peer Series-C startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alon, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a raise, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Sensi AI either way.
